Browser verification was a HYDRATED harness, not the live Admin: the real route modules (loader, action, component) bundled with vite against in-memory stubs for auth and the repositories (the repository stub throws on a NULL in the active value column, emulating chk_expense_rule_value_shape), driven in Chromium with the real polaris.js from the CDN; app-bridge.js was NOT loaded (it cannot start outside the Admin iframe) and window.shopify.toast was a recording stub. Harness sources are under dev-evidence/g4-sprint-3.5-ui-pass2/tools/harness/.

B1 (currency select blank) was NOT reproducible in this harness on the OLD code either: 9 server-render+hydrate loads (USD/CAD/GBP), a run with polaris.js delayed 3 s (upgrade after hydration), and a client-side navigation all showed the correct option with the old value= prop. The fix follows the human's/QA's direction (no value=, selected on the option) and additionally makes a blank select harmless (currency is submitted from state via a hidden input and a blank/invalid currency now shows an error and disables Calculate), but whether the blank is gone in the live Admin can only be confirmed there.

Number-input limitation: Polaris s-number-field wraps <input type=number>, which the browser will not let a person type '1,5' or 'abc' into (its value becomes ''), so live typing yields the empty-field message for those. The comma/non-numeric messages are reached only by a direct/crafted POST (covered by unit tests on the action); typed '-5', '.5', '1e5', '10.555' get their specific messages live.

The task text asked for 'revenue 100000 with cogs 5000 + shipping 45000 -> dashes 10 and 90'. Under the stated ring rule (share of revenue when revenue > 0 and the total is <= 100%) that input yields 5 and 45, not 10 and 90 (50000 of 100000 fits inside revenue). 10 and 90 are what share-of-total-expenses gives, so the tests pin BOTH: revenue 10000c (expenses exceed it) -> dashes 10 and 90; revenue 100000c -> dashes 5 and 45.

The task said no other agent was editing; during this run another agent (or the human) created/edited db/config/config.cjs, db/config/migrate-guard.cjs, .sequelizerc, .env.example, tests/README.md, tests/architecture/migrate-guard.test.ts, design/v2/*, listing-assets/logo/* and made commits 5659a8b/3f7135f/4745ac2, and staged some of my files in the index. Only the 25 paths of 9d6407f were committed (git commit -- <paths>); the others were left exactly as found.

Not fixed on purpose (product decisions, disclosed): tiered-by-revenue-band formula cliff ($500 at $10,000.00 -> $350 at +1 cent); no cap at 100% for percentage rules (cap is 1000%) and no warning when percentages sum past 100; Back-navigation to the calculator loses unsaved inputs. Not done: moving the per-category enable checkbox out of <summary> (only relabelled it with aria-label; a full fix needs a layout restructure); the App Bridge save bar's own Save button has no loading state that this page controls; the calculator shows 'Needs attention' inline errors on a DISABLED row with a blank value (required for Save) while Calculate stays allowed, since a disabled row does not take part in a calculation.
live_store_items: Left sidebar: the app entry 'Expense Calculator' lists ONLY 'History' as a child (no 'Calculator' child); clicking the app name opens /app/calculator; History highlights on /app/history and /app/history/:id. Opening the app from the Apps list and a bare /app hit both land on the calculator.

Currency select on /app/calculator shows 'USD - US Dollar' immediately (no blank flash) on a fresh open, after client-side navigation from History, and after 'Duplicate as new calculation' from a CAD/EUR/GBP snapshot (this was NOT reproducible outside the Admin - confirm it is gone there).

Contextual save bar: change a rule -> the bar appears; Discard restores rules, revenue AND currency and clears any error banner/summary; Save with a category whose value is cleared and which is unticked shows the 'Rule changes not saved' banner and 'Needs attention' on that row instead of the error page; a good Save shows the 'Rule changes saved' toast exactly once (not again on reload or when coming back to the page).
Calculate button shows its loading spinner while working and cannot be double-submitted; the 'Save this calculation' buttons on Results show loading while saving.
Revenue field: typing -5 shows 'Revenue amount must be zero or greater.' inline and disables Calculate; 0 and 1,234.50 are accepted.

Results at revenue 0 shows the donut (not 'No data') with the 'share of total expenses' caption; with the seeded defaults at $1,000 revenue (expenses > revenue) the donut ring is complete with no overlapping arcs.

Narrow Admin window (~400-600px): the results and history tables scroll sideways inside their own box and the page itself does not gain a horizontal scrollbar; the enable checkbox in each category header is announced as 'Enable <category> rule' by a screen reader and does not open/close the row.
